artifact.note: Validated the self-contained package and reviewed the responsive layout, canvas rendering, snowfall animation, glass highlights, mountain parallax, pointer-drag rotation, Shake and Reset controls, and live local-time detail. The result is a polished, dependency-free interactive snow globe experience in a single index.html.
